name: Junior Docent Program
what_you_do: Teens take part in a four-year junior docent program at the Hudson River Museum. After two full years and a staff review, students can qualify to be paid.
who_can_apply: Freshmen or sophomores at a Yonkers public high school. Academic merit is not a factor.
pay_detail: Unpaid at first. After two full years and a staff review, plus a Payroll Evaluation Tour, students can be paid for weekend work.
duration: Four years. Foundation Junior Docents meet Wednesdays 3 to 5 pm; Core Junior Docents meet Fridays 3 to 5 pm.
deadline_text: 2026-27 portal is open. Deadline October 30, 2026 at 8 pm. New recruit meetings begin in December 2026.
how_to_apply: Fill out the online application. Add a recommendation form with two letters from a teacher, counselor, coach or mentor. Then do an interview with the Program Manager. Contact Pedro Betanzos at pbetanzos@hrm.org or 914-963-4550 ext. 219.
notes: Only for Yonkers public school students. The page gives the deadline as Wednesday in one spot and Friday in another. Oct 30, 2026 is a Friday, so confirm with the museum.
